svg.aria-label: Event sourcing and CQRS for a conference booking system. A user sends a command such as book seat; it is validated against current state and, if accepted, becomes an immutable event like seat booked that is appended to the event log. Separate projections read the log and build read-optimised views: seat availability, attendee badges and invoices. Writes go to the log; reads go to the views; any view can be rebuilt by replaying the log.
svg.title: Event sourcing and CQRS for a conference booking system. A user sends a command such as book seat; it is validated against current state and, if accepted, becomes an immutable event like seat booked that is appended to the event log. Separate projections read the log and build read-optimised views: seat availability, attendee badges and invoices. Writes go to the log; reads go to the views; any view can be rebuilt by replaying the log.
svg.text: write side: the log is the truth
read side: views are derived, rebuildable by replay
